summary.text: Julie Won represents the 26th District on the New York City Council in western Queens, which covers Long Island City, Sunnyside, Astoria and Woodside.
Her Council biography says she is the first woman and immigrant to represent the district.

paragraphs.text: Won immigrated to New York City with her family at the age of eight, according to her Council biography.
She worked at IBM for a decade as an advisor to the federal government on agency technology.

Before her election she served on Queens Community Board 2 and on the boards of several community organizations, co-founded the Queens Small Business Alliance, and founded the Tech Action Group for the Queens Borough President's 2020 census Complete Count Committee.
